purpose: Reassess previously insufficient semantic-basis records against the enriched multi-authority RRE evidence set without allowing evidence count, market-data volume or provider presence alone to promote grammar/domain support.
rules: Only baseline semantic-basis records with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE are reassessed automatically.
Reassessment compares evidence lineage and authority composition, not source count voting.
A MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER series may strengthen longitudinal or pressure context but cannot by itself prove canonical Constraint, Reconfiguration or Continuity.
G2 Constraint requires evidence of a mechanism that actually narrows feasible possibilities or channels behavior under pressure.
G14 Reconfiguration requires before/after evidence of changed structure, routing, carrier arrangement, institutional organization or relationship topology.
G16 Continuity requires evidence that a reality pattern, function or organized relation persists across time/states/carriers, not merely that observations exist at multiple dates.
P3 requires persistence/maintenance/recovery/calibration/governance/adaptation evidence; elapsed time alone is insufficient.

Any promotion from INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE to EVIDENCE_READY requires at least one newly admitted evidence record whose claim text directly satisfies the missing semantic mechanism, not just a broader date window.
The original W8E semantic-basis file remains unchanged. W8E-P2 writes a separate reassessment record.
